name: Wassenger
description: Wassenger WhatsApp API: list connected numbers and their session health, send WhatsApp text messages, track delivery, and read chats, chat history and contacts of a number.
instructions:
Wassenger connects WhatsApp numbers to an API. A number linked by QR code (connector `web`) runs a WhatsApp Web session, an unofficial channel that WhatsApp may restrict for bulk or unsolicited sending. Numbers on the `cloud` connector use Meta's official Business API.

**Getting credentials**: in the Wassenger Web Console open Developers, then API Keys, and copy or create a key into `WASSENGER_API_TOKEN`. Chat agents and supervisors cannot use the API, so use an owner or admin key. Link your WhatsApp number in the console first (scan the QR code); a number that is not online cannot send.

**Workflow**: call `wassenger_list_numbers` first. It returns each number's `id` (24 hex characters), used as `device_id` by the chat, contact and health tools, and as `device` when sending from a specific number. `wassenger_get_number_health` explains why a number is not sending (`authorize` means scan the QR code again).

**Sending**: `wassenger_send_message` sends a real WhatsApp message. Confirm the recipient and the exact text with the user before calling it, and do not retry after it returns an `id`. Messages are queued; check them later with `wassenger_get_message` or `wassenger_search_sent_messages`, and `wassenger_get_message_ack_info` for read receipts.

**Formats**: phone numbers are E.164 with the plus sign, e.g. `+447911123456`. Chat and contact IDs are WhatsApp IDs such as `447911123456@c.us` (person) or `120363012345678901@g.us` (group).

**Plans and limits**: Gateway plans are send-only; reading chat history needs a Platform plan, and those tools answer 403 "Platform plan upgrade required" otherwise. Delivery speed per minute and the queue size depend on the plan. `wassenger_check_number` uses the monthly number-check quota (2,000 to 50,000 by plan); keep it under 30 checks per minute. The API returns `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining` and `x-ratelimit-reset` headers, exposed on the list tools; on 429 wait until the reset time.

**Pagination**: list tools take `page`, starting at 0, and `size`. Ask for the next page until fewer than `size` items come back.

**Cloud reachability**: `api.wassenger.com` is a public HTTPS API, reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud.

WASSENGER_API_TOKEN.label: Wassenger API key
WASSENGER_API_TOKEN.help: Wassenger Web Console, Developers, API Keys: copy or create a key (owner or admin user).
WASSENGER_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the API key (letters and digits), without a header name or URL.

tools.name: wassenger_list_numbers
tools.description: List the WhatsApp numbers (devices) in the Wassenger account with ID, phone, alias, connector, session status, plan and queue. Call this first: the id is the device_id the other tools need.

search.description: Match by phone number, alias or ID, e.g. +447911123456.

sessionStatus.description: Only numbers whose WhatsApp session is in this state.

tools.name: wassenger_get_number_health
tools.description: Get the session health of one number: status (online, authorize, timeout, conflict...), subscription state, whether it is operative now, last sync and queue capacity. Use it when messages are not going out.

device_id.description: Number (device) ID from wassenger_list_numbers, 24 hex characters.

tools.name: wassenger_check_number
tools.description: Check in real time whether a phone number exists on WhatsApp and can receive messages. Read-only, but it uses the plan's monthly number-check quota and needs the number session online; keep under 30 checks per minute.

phone.description: Number in E.164 format with +, e.g. +447911123456.

tools.name: wassenger_send_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message to a phone number or a group through a connected number. This sends a real message: confirm the recipient and the exact text with the user before calling, and do not retry after an id is returned.

phone.description: Recipient in E.164 format with +, e.g. +447911123456. Use group instead for a group chat.

group.description: Group chat WhatsApp ID, e.g. 120363012345678901@g.us. Use instead of phone.

message.description: Text to send. Supports WhatsApp *bold*, _italic_ and line breaks.

device.description: Number (device) ID to send from; omit to use the first connected number.

reference.description: Optional own reference, e.g. a CRM ticket ID, returned with the message and its webhooks.

tools.name: wassenger_get_message
tools.description: Get one outbound message by its Wassenger ID (24 hex) or WhatsApp ID, including status, delivery status (queued, sent, delivered, read, failed) and the reason when it failed.

message_id.description: Message id returned by wassenger_send_message, or its WhatsApp message ID.

tools.name: wassenger_search_sent_messages
tools.description: Search outbound messages (sent, queued or failed) by text, recipient, number, status or delivery status, newest first. Inbound messages are not included: use wassenger_get_chat_messages for those.

search.description: Text content, phone number, group or message ID to match.

phone.description: Only messages to this E.164 number.

device.description: Only messages sent from this number ID or phone.

status.description: Comma-separated: queued, processing, processed, failed, expired, invalid, removed.

deliveryStatus.description: Comma-separated: queued, sent, delivered, read, played, failed, cancelled, revoked.

createdAfter.description: Only messages created after this ISO 8601 date, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: wassenger_get_message_ack_info
tools.description: Get who received, read or played an outbound message sent in the last 30 days, for person and group chats. Use it to confirm a message was actually read.

device_id.description: Number (device) ID that sent the message.

message_wid.description: WhatsApp message ID (waId of the sent message).

tools.name: wassenger_list_chats
tools.description: List or search the chats of one number (people, groups, channels) with status, unread count, labels and assigned agent. Filter by text, status or unread to find a conversation.

search.description: Free text matched against phone, chat or contact name, email, company or notes.

status.description: Comma-separated chat status: pending, active, resolved, archived, muted, banned, removed.

unread.description: True for chats with unread messages only.

type.description: Comma-separated chat type: chat, group, community, channel.

tools.name: wassenger_get_chat_messages
tools.description: Read inbound and outbound messages of one number, across chats or within one chat, newest first. Requires a Platform plan on that number; filter by chat ID, direction, text or date.

flow.description: in for received, out for sent messages.

search.description: Partial text, contact name or media file name.

after.description: Only messages created after this ISO 8601 date.

before.description: Only messages created before this ISO 8601 date.

tools.name: wassenger_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search the contacts stored for one number by name, phone, email, company or notes, with their WhatsApp ID, type and metadata.

search.description: Name, phone, email, company, metadata or notes to match.

phone.description: Comma-separated phone numbers or WhatsApp IDs, e.g. +447911123456.

tools.name: wassenger_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact or group of a number by WhatsApp ID or phone number, with name, profile details and stored metadata.

contact_wid.description: WhatsApp ID or phone number, e.g. 447911123456@c.us.
